source_rules.transform: standard recursive Heikin-Ashi transform, initialized from first raw open
source_rules.claimed_long: two bearish candles; current no-upper-wick candle has a larger body
source_rules.claimed_exit: two bullish candles; current candle has no lower wick
source_rules.position_limit: at most three accumulated 100-share entries; an exit clears all

defects_and_ambiguities: The claimed long condition is bearish and the exit condition bullish, reversing the stated momentum intent.
Exact floating-point equality is used for no-wick detection.
The cumulative-state column is mutated through chained indexing and can be temporarily stale after a clear-all reassignment.
Fixed 100-share entries and 10000 capital make exposure depend on the asset's nominal price and can create leverage.
The plotted portfolio is sliced to the final 50 observations while statistics mix the sliced portfolio with the unsliced signal history.
Its benchmark Sharpe, Omega, Sortino, CAGR labels, and degrees-of-freedom treatment are nonstandard or dimensionally inconsistent.
No costs, uncertainty analysis, negative controls, universe test, or explicit next-period execution audit are provided.
independent_treatment: Test both the literal source direction and a predeclared direction-corrected interpretation. Preserve the three-unit state concept with safe capped unit-proportional weights, causal next-close returns, realistic costs, controls, and portfolio gates.
